actionable_steps.citation: The prop you need — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 7 (1967), 1967-03-27
actionable_steps.step: Approach Nature in a humble, prayerful mood — to understand the intelligence that guides the universe, not merely for comfort and use.

actionable_steps.citation: Nature: God: Man — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-07-12
actionable_steps.step: Learn Nature's foremost lesson: do service with no expectation of return, the way the seasons keep their cycle without asking.

actionable_steps.citation: Integral approach to human ailments — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 26 (1993), 1993-02-06
actionable_steps.step: Make purifying the environment your primary task — cut pollution of air, water and food, and favour the growing of trees.

actionable_steps.citation: Nature: God: Man — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-07-12
actionable_steps.step: Practise daily gratitude for Nature's countless gifts — the five elements, the seasons, the air you breathe — instead of taking them as your due.

actionable_steps.citation: Out of the workshop — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 14 (1978 - 80), 1979-06-21
actionable_steps.step: Study Nature as your best teacher — observe a river, a tree, a bird this week and write down the one lesson it teaches you.

definition.citation: The prop you need — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 7 (1967), 1967-03-27
definition.quote: Nature is the name for all the various items that impress upon man, the glory and the splendour of God.

discourses.citation: Nature: God: Man — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-07-12
discourses.quote: While he is receiving countless gifts from Providence, he is offering nothing in return to Nature or God. … Man is not learning the great lessons Nature is teaching him. The foremost lesson is doing service with no expectation of return.

discourses.citation: True Sacrifice — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21 (1988), 1988-06-26
discourses.quote: The trees bear fruit for the benefit of others; Rivers flow for the good of others; Cows give milk to nourish others; The human body is for rendering service.

discourses.citation: Out of the workshop — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 14 (1978 - 80), 1979-06-21
discourses.quote: THE Universe is the best University for man; Nature is his best teacher. With an observant mind he can learn many lessons from rivers and hills, from birds and beasts, from stars and flowers and from trees.

discourses.citation: Integral approach to human ailments — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 26 (1993), 1993-02-06
discourses.quote: The primary task is to purify the environment which is affected by pollution of air, water and food. All the five elements are affected by pollution.

make_it_real: The tree never asks who eats its fruit. Today, give something to someone without keeping score — that is Nature's lesson, learned.
title: Nature & Environment
